questions.answer: Brent over WTI was 0.54 USD/bbl on 10 November 2026 (price_board_spreads, variable brent_minus_wti, derived table). A compare call on those two prices gave a Brent-minus-WTI difference of 0.54 USD/bbl, the same figure. These are EIA daily spot prices by trading date (the date is shown at 00:00Z).

questions.question: How much crude oil did the United States import from Canada in 2025?
questions.answer: I can't give a figure for 2025 Canadian crude imports. The warehouse has a table for it, eia_crude_imports_by_country (public, source tier, EIA monthly series, Canada is MCRIMUSCA2, last month held 2026-08). But the live set this chat reads doesn't include that table, and my queries against it were refused. EIA's weekly trade table, eia_petroleum_trade_weekly, is also outside the live set, and it only reports total crude imports, not Canada alone. Its full history is on Redivis, where you can sum MCRIMUSCA2 over the 12 months of 2025. I have stated no numbers because no tool result gave one.
